name: usage-band
description: Shows plan usage (5h and weekly limits), context fill and session cost beside the prompt

position.title: Position
position.description: hint-line: at the right end of the line under the prompt, no colors; above-prompt: a line above the prompt, percentages colored

showResets.title: Show reset times
showResets.description: Show when each rate-limit window resets, e.g. (4h0m)

showContext.title: Show context fill
showContext.description: Show how full the context window is (ctx)

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Show what the session has cost so far ($)

warnAt.title: Warning threshold, %
warnAt.description: From this percentage a value is marked with ! on the hint line, red above the prompt (yellow from 20 below it); 0 turns it off
